name: rect
description: Rectangle with its pivot at x/y; centered by default (originX/originY move the pivot within the shape).
help: Rectangle with its pivot at x/y; centered by default (originX/originY move the pivot).

originX.help: Where the pivot sits inside the shape, as a fraction of the width: 0 = left edge, 0.5 = center, 1 = right edge.
originX.description: Where the pivot (x/y) sits within the shape, as a fraction of the width: 0 = left edge, 0.5 = center, 1 = right edge.

originY.help: Where the pivot sits inside the shape, as a fraction of the height: 0 = top edge, 0.5 = center, 1 = bottom edge.
originY.description: Where the pivot sits within the shape, as a fraction of the height: 0 = top edge, 0.5 = center, 1 = bottom edge.
